description: This PHP script is a system information page for phpSysInfo, generating XML, WML, or HTML output with system vitals, network, hardware, memory, filesystems, and temperature data. It includes external files for classes, configuration, and XML data generation.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Class for error handling and reporting within the script.

classes.name: sysinfo
classes.description: Class representing system information, instantiated as $sysinfo.

classes.name: mbinfo
classes.description: Class for motherboard information, instantiated as $mbinfo.

classes.name: XPath
classes.description: Class for XML data parsing and XPath queries.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: Template engine class for HTML output.

methods.name: addError
methods.description: Adds an error message to the error object.

methods.name: ErrorsExist
methods.description: Checks if any errors have been recorded.

methods.name: ErrorsAsHTML
methods.description: Returns all errors formatted as HTML.

methods.name: importFromString
methods.description: Imports XML data from a string into XPath object.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves data from XML via XPath.
